adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in packages/core/EventManager.ts around line 344, when a destination calendar credential ID is provided, the code fetches the credential from the database without verifying that the credential belongs to an authorized user/team member. The code at lines 346-368 shows that if the credential isn't found in this.calendarCredentials, it fetches directly from prisma.credential.findUnique using only the credentialId from the destination calendar, without any authorization check to verify the credential belongs to the current user or an authorized collective host. This could allow creating calendar events using another tenant's credentials if an attacker can manipulate the destinationCalendar.credentialId value.
